cards.text: Abijah, king of Judah, rests with his fathers and is buried in the City of David. His son Asa takes the throne. I bet all of Judah is leaning in like it's the first day with a new boss: okay, buddy, what are YOU gonna be like?

cards.question: In Asa's days, the land was at peace for ___ years.

answers.text: ten
forty
seven

cards.question: True or false: King Asa did what was good and right in the eyes of the LORD his God.

answers.text: True
False

cards.text: And Asa gets to WORK: he removes the foreign altars and high places, shatters the sacred pillars and chops DOWN the Asherah poles. That's not tidying up, friend, that's the deep clean where even the junk drawer gets emptied, and trust me, I know how rare THAT is.

cards.question: King Asa has cleared out the foreign altars. Then what does he command the people of Judah to do?

answers.text: Seek the LORD and keep His law
Build a new temple in Jerusalem
Gather an army against Israel

cards.text: He also removes the high places and incense altars from all the cities of Judah. And under Asa, the kingdom is at peace.

cards.question: Judah is at peace under King Asa. What does Asa do with that quiet time?

answers.text: He builds fortified cities in Judah
He sends gifts to the king of Egypt
He marches out to conquer Israel

cards.question: True or false: While Asa was building his cities, kings on every side were making war with him.

answers.text: True
False

cards.text: Asa tells the people of Judah, “Let us build these cities and surround them with walls and towers, with doors and bars.” Friend, that's locking the door, bolting it AND shoving a chair under the handle.

cards.question: King Asa tells Judah the land is still theirs. What reason does he give?

answers.text: They have sought the LORD their God
Their army is bigger than any other
Abijah won it for them in battle

cards.text: So Judah builds and prospers, and Asa has an army of mighty men: 300,000 from Judah with large shields and spears, and 280,000 from Benjamin with small shields and bows. Then Zerah the Cushite, a man from the land of Cush, comes against them.

cards.question: Zerah the Cushite marches on Judah. How big is his army?

answers.text: A million men and 300 chariots
Half a million men and 900 chariots
Two hundred thousand men and 600 chariots

cards.text: Zerah gets as far as Mareshah, so Asa marches out and lines up for battle in the Valley of Zephathah nearby. 580 thousand against a MILLION is not a battle line, friend, that's a whole stadium showing up at your front door.

cards.question: King Asa is lined up in the Valley of Zephathah, facing Zerah's million men. What does Asa do?

answers.text: He cries out to the LORD his God
He sends messengers to ask for peace
He pulls his army back to Jerusalem

cards.question: Asa prays, “O LORD, there is no one besides You to help the powerless against the mighty.” How does he end his prayer?

answers.text: Do not let a mere mortal prevail against You
Do not let our walls fall before this army
Do not let this multitude reach Jerusalem

cards.question: King Asa has prayed. What happens to Zerah's Cushite army?

answers.text: The LORD strikes them down and they flee
They surrender and pay Asa tribute
They camp and wait for more troops

cards.text: Asa and his army chase them as far as Gerar. Remember that stadium at the front door? Now it's the stadium emptying out after the game, and EVERYBODY is trying to beat traffic.

cards.question: True or false: After the chase to Gerar, the Cushites regroup and come back at Judah for another round.

answers.text: True
False

cards.question: Judah carries off a great amount of plunder and attacks all the cities around Gerar, because something had fallen upon them. What was it?

answers.text: The terror of the LORD
A long and heavy drought
A plague from the east

cards.text: They plunder all those cities, hit the herdsmen's tents, carry off many sheep and camels, and then head home to Jerusalem. And that's where we'll leave King Asa for now, but stick around, friend, because his story is far from done.
